sunday.sidecar.autoStart.description: Start the sundayd sidecar automatically when the extension activates.

sunday.sidecar.path.description: Absolute path to the sundayd entrypoint (e.g. packages/sundayd/dist/cli.js). Empty = auto-discover (bundled → workspace → PATH).

sunday.completion.debounceMs.description: Per-document debounce (ms) before a keystroke burst triggers a completion request to the sidecar.

sunday.completion.enabled.description: Enable Sunday ghost-text inline completions (Tab to accept) for all languages.

sunday.completion.model.description: Model ref ("provider:model") used for inline completions. Fast/cheap models recommended; providers without a native FIM endpoint fall back to a prefix-only chat continuation.

sunday.nextEdit.enabled.description: Experimental: after a rename-like edit, suggest applying the same rename to the next occurrence via CodeLens. Default off.

sunday.voice.inputEnabled.description: Experimental: show a microphone button in the chat input for voice dictation via the browser Web Speech API (on-device; no audio leaves your machine). Default off.

sunday.voice.outputEnabled.description: Experimental: speak agent responses aloud via the browser speechSynthesis API (on-device). Default off.

sunday.orchestration.parallel.description: Run orchestration units in parallel worktrees when true. Default false (sequential) per ADR-17 — stays off until the parallel benchmark passes.

sunday.backgroundAgents.enabled.description: Experimental: background agents that run detached in the per-user daemon and open GitHub PRs on completion. Default off.

sunday.browser.enabled.description: Opt in to the agent browser (browserd). When off, browser_* tools return a disabled error.

sunday.localModel.enabled.description: Use a local Ollama model (qwen2.5-coder:1.5b) for ghost-text completions when available. Completions silently fall back to API providers when Ollama is not running. Applies on the next sidecar (re)start.

sunday.sandbox.mode.description: Sandbox for agent-run shell commands. off = run on the host (current behavior); docker = disposable container with networking disabled; bubblewrap = Linux bwrap with an unshared network namespace. Applies on the next sidecar restart.

sunday.sandbox.dockerImage.description: Container image for sunday.sandbox.mode=docker. Must be present locally (docker pull it once); empty = alpine:latest.
